newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MPC TO RETIRE $200 MLN DEBT FROM ING BANK.
newsitem.headline: MPC TO RETIRE $200 MLN DEBT FROM ING BANK.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp plans to retire within the year its $200 million loan from ING Bank, the chairman of MPC's parent firm said on Monday.
First Pacific Co Ltd chairman Manuel Pangilinan told stock brokers MPC hoped to repay the loans through a combination of equity and borrowings.
MPC acquired the loans after it bought out the Filinvest group's 16 percent stake in Bonifacio Land Corp, making it Bonifacio Land's majority owner.
Bonifacio Land is made up of 17 private firms which hold 55 percent of Fort Bonifacio Development Corp, developer of a 214-hectare lot on the edge of Manila's Makati financial district.
